description: llama-bench tg128 sweep across expert-layer offload counts (ncmoe N = number of MoE layers keeping experts on CPU). Small fixed context; exposes the VRAM frontier.

hardware.profile: consumer desktop, DDR4 dual channel, 12 GB GPU
notes: PLE n-gram table pinned to CPU via tensor override
ncmoe 42/44 are the peak-throughput configs but fail to load once the full 262144-token KV and compute buffers are added (1224 MiB KV allocation OOM).
The long-context configuration therefore runs ncmoe 48 at about 14.7 tok/s; the short-context fast configuration is ncmoe 42-44 at up to 18.9 tok/s.
The tradeoff is a one-line entrypoint switch: CTX_SIZE plus ncmoe.
caveats: Sweep ran at 512-token context; long-context load behavior tested separately with the real 262K server.
